description: The Kroger Co. was founded in 1883 and incorporated in 1902, and its company is built on the foundation of its retail grocery business, which includes the added convenience of its retail pharmacies and fuel centers, with a strategy focused on growing households and increasing customer loyalty by delivering great value and convenience and investing in Fresh, Our Brands, Personalization and eCommerce. It utilizes the data and traffic generated by its retail business to create personalized experiences and value for its customers, and that data and traffic also enable its fast-growing, high operating margin alternative profit business, including third-party media revenue, and in turn the value generated from these businesses enables it to reinvest back into its retail business. Revenues are predominately earned and cash is generated as consumer products are sold to customers in its stores and fuel centers and via its online platforms, and its Our Brands play an important role in its merchandising strategy, representing over $39 billion of sales in 2025, with its supermarkets on average stocking over 13,000 private label items.
